summary: Sysco filed a preliminary 424B5 for a $1,000,000,000 common stock offering on September 14, 2026, with a $150,000,000 overallotment option. Net proceeds, alongside other financing and cash, fund the cash component of its March 30, 2026 merger agreement to acquire JRD Unico, Inc. and Warehouse Realty, LLC (Jetro Restaurant Depot) in a cash-and-stock deal through a new holding company, Sysco Holdings, expected to list on the NYSE. The offering is not contingent on closing; absent completion, proceeds go to general corporate purposes. Watch regulatory approval timing, deal financing risk, and potential stock overhang.
